d: Uttar pradesh kangres ke varishth neta rajendr pal gautam dvara bihar ke mantri nitin navin aur bihar ko lekar di gaee vivadit tippani ke bad patna ki rajniti garma gaee hai. bihar men sattarurh endie (NDA) ke ghatak dalon- bhajpa, jediyu, hindustani aavam morcha (HAM) aur lojpa (ramvilas) ke pravaktaon ne ek sur men kangres par karara hamla bola hai.
